name: Sotto self-host with Photon
status: definition only; create in Railway Template Editor before sharing a deploy link

service.port: 8080; the helper creates the public domain with this target, verified live with the receiver's injected PORT

BRIDGE_TOKEN.description: Unique Bridge bearer for this deployment

GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY.description: Owner-provided Google AI Studio API key

PHOTON_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Owner's registered phone number in exact E.164 form (+ and country code); an Apple ID email never activates self-host

PHOTON_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Exact owner identity only; no wildcard or extra users

railwayDashboard: Repository is the public Sotto distribution or owner's fork; root directory is blank
Service has a /data volume and generated public domain
BRIDGE_TOKEN is nonempty and differs from other deployments
runtimeSignals: Logs show Gemini key/model OK and Photon gateway connected
Owner sends an inbound hello from the configured identity and receives a reply
The first brief is visibly received on the owner's device
